core_style.default_register: casual - often uses humor to diffuse tension
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs - frequently elaborates on thoughts with additional details
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick to respond with humor or emotion
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more serious tone when discussing family matters or feelings

humor.frequency: occasional - spikes during social interactions or when feeling insecure
humor.mechanism: understatement - often downplays his own quirks or mistakes for comedic effect

structural_patterns: asks a question then answers it immediately
speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses playful nicknames for people and things, revealing a desire for intimacy and connection
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often revealing vulnerability

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and pauses to gather thoughts

worldview.family is paramount: demonstrates this by prioritizing his daughter and partner in conversations
worldview.self-acceptance is important: expresses pride in his identity and experiences, such as his childhood

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: believes he is a fun-loving, creative parent
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often feels insecure and overcompensates with humor and flamboyance
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive or overly humorous when his parenting is questioned

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor to deflect serious topics, maintaining a light tone
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes more fragmented, and he may express concern directly
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, revealing his pain
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks confidently, often using humor to assert dominance in social situations

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to banter, but if that fails, he may become defensive or withdraw
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with humor and sarcasm, often questioning their decisions
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes very protective and assertive, often raising his voice
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: tends to redirect the conversation or make a joke to deflect the embarrassment

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, then becomes defensive if challenged, and may escalate to emotional appeals if pushed further
conversation_goals: assert his role as a caring parent

relationship_matrix.MITCHELL: partner - seeks mutual support and understanding
relationship_matrix.LILY: daughter - protective and nurturing, wants to create a loving environment
relationship_matrix.CLAIRE: sister-in-law - often challenges him, leading to humorous exchanges

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as a fun and creative parent
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view him as flamboyant and sometimes overly dramatic
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between wanting to be taken seriously as a parent and being perceived as a stereotype
